summary: Every person ask has a deadline (24h unless the ask or `[asks] default_deadline` says otherwise) and an optional default answer; an unanswered ask resolves by itself at its deadline, recorded as resolved by deadline, and the asking step resumes

replay.detail: No graph replay. An ask made by an older build has no deadline field; its deadline is counted from the first start of this build (person_ask_deadlines_since_unix_ms, written once into meta at store open), so open asks do not all resolve at deploy.

schema.detail: Additive claim fields: work.person-asked gains deadline_unix_ms, deadline_ms (only when the asker named a deadline) and default_answer, work.person-done and work.person-cancelled gain resolved_by. One meta key, local to the member. Storage version is unchanged.

rules.detail: Checkpoint rules and digests are unchanged.

compatibility.detail: A member on an older build does not know the new claim fields and keeps such claims as retryable until it upgrades, as with any added field. The client contract gains work.ask deadline_ms and default_answer and an optional resolved_by field on answers; no answer outcome is added. An ask resolved at its deadline carries its default answer with that answer's own outcome (accept, decline or selected), or no answer, so an older client decodes it and, not knowing resolved_by, shows the default as the answer. Rollout: daemons before clients, as for any optional field.

downtime.detail: No downtime. The meta key is written in the existing store-open migration.

manual.detail: No manual step. An operator may set [asks] default_deadline (1m to 30d) in the daemon config; it reloads with the other daemon policies.

recovery.detail: Revert. An older build keeps claims carrying the new fields as retryable; asks already resolved by deadline stay resolved.
